title: Graffiti Mint
tagline: A Dapp to digitize and mint street art from IRL graffiti events
description:
This project helps to digitize, mint, and monetize graffiti events. It integrates ERC1155 NFTs for 4-tier season passes for event supporters and ERC751 contracts to mint street art made in graffiti events at city parks as NFTs.

Event supporters get an OG NFT from each artwork made at events from their season pass and artists get the funds for the auction of Event Edition NFTs and a percentage of the OG NFTs sales.
how_its_made: We used Polygon Academy Marketplace and ScaffoldETH repositories to build a react App ready to web3 interactions, an ERC721 contract template from Open Zeppelin to mint the NFTs, Piñata to pin images to IPFS, Moralis quick node to deploy on Polygon POS network, and Unlock for a Season Pass for avid art collectors.
